# TPF Technology

> A software studio that builds websites, web applications, online shops, Telegram bots and process automation with a team of AI agents overseen by engineers — from request to launch. The spec and estimate are free and come before any payment; payment is 50/50 (before start and after acceptance); the client owns the source code and all rights.

Works in English, Russian and Chinese. Orders are taken through the form on the site or by e-mail: orders@tpf-technology.com. After a request the client receives the spec, estimate and timeline by e-mail, usually within an hour, and follows the order status on a personal order page.

## Pages

- [English](https://tpf-technology.com/en): services, prices, selected work, request form
- [Русский](https://tpf-technology.com/ru): услуги, цены, проекты, форма заявки
- [中文](https://tpf-technology.com/zh): 服务、价格、项目、需求表单
- [Websites and landing pages](https://tpf-technology.com/en/websites)
- [Web applications](https://tpf-technology.com/en/web-apps)
- [Online shops](https://tpf-technology.com/en/online-shops)
- [Telegram bots](https://tpf-technology.com/en/telegram-bots)
- [Privacy policy](https://tpf-technology.com/privacy): what data is collected and how to have it removed

## What the studio builds

- Landing pages and multi-page websites with a request form delivered to the client's e-mail
- Web applications with a database and an admin area: bookings, requests, catalogues, schedules, user accounts with roles
- Online shops: catalogue, cart, checkout, card payments into the client's own Stripe, YooKassa or bePaid account
- Telegram bots: button menus, answers to frequent questions, step-by-step booking or ordering, a web admin area
- Process automation: requests, reminders, documents and data exchange between services run by themselves in an application built around the client's process
- Mobile apps as installable web applications (own icon, full screen, no app stores)

## Prices

Current "from" prices in euros and US dollars are listed at https://tpf-technology.com/en#prices. The price depends on the scope; anything not on the list is sized and priced by estimate.

## Technology

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Vercel, PWA, Telegram, Stripe.
